name: lounge-os
description: Hybrid (local + cloud) management system for PlayStation / VR gaming lounges with cafeteria

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lounge/server" "npm run dev -w @lounge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lounge/web && npm run build -w @lounge/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lounge/core && npm run test -w @lounge/server && npm run test -w @lounge/web
